Genuinely zero forward-looking event data to emit today, so not building against fabricated dates. Re-derive later (likely Sept/Oct, once WM39 programme goes live): fetch https://www.wienmodern.at/kalender, follow redirect to <year>-kalender, then fetch <that>-details for the real listing; parse .Calendar-day-production articles (title h2, category h6.hd-sub, date from parent #day-YYYYMMDD id + Production-time text, venue link text, data-zip for district, morelink href for detail-page url/price).
